name: armed forces expeditionary
size_citation: Ribbon bar 1 3/8 in x 3/8 in (11:3): DoDM 1348.33 (military decorations, ribbons and devices) and CAPR 39-1 as carried in js/state.js RIBBON_HEIGHT; paragraph numbers to be confirmed against the current publications

quality.color_source: clean palette colour per stripe (ribbon-palette.json), the named colour each stripe's measured thread colour belongs to, stripe table of the decoration in the Institute of Heraldry colour names, read in the decoration's Wikipedia article (viewed, nothing saved): green, golden yellow, spice brown, black, bluebird, ultramarine, white, scarlet settling the close calls; the thread colours of the product photograph (tools/military/ribbon-lit.js) are the earlier measurement and are kept in measurement.restyle.measured_hex, geometry unchanged except as listed in measurement.restyle.repairs
quality.geometry_source: Vanguard product photograph, rectified, mirrored boundaries snapped

measurement.method: Rectified from the Vanguard product photograph; stripes segmented along the width by a dynamic programme on one thread colour per column; each stripe's colour read from its inner threads (tools/military/ribbon-lit.js), equal colours clustered, mirrored boundaries snapped. Measured by script; the photograph is a measurement reference only and is not shipped
measurement.note: colours are the thread colour of the stripe, not the mean of the photo; the first pass measured low-resolution photos: {"fidelity":"measured","stripes":13,"orientation":"vertical-stripes","color_source":"measured raster, snapped to the repo palette"}

decided_by: stripe table of the decoration in the Institute of Heraldry colour names, read in the decoration's Wikipedia article (viewed, nothing saved): green, golden yellow, spice brown, black, bluebird, ultramarine, white, scarlet
restyle.basis: stripe table of the decoration in the Institute of Heraldry colour names, read in the decoration's Wikipedia article (viewed, nothing saved): green, golden yellow, spice brown, black, bluebird, ultramarine, white, scarlet

fit.method: CIEDE2000, stripe hex against the stripe's own lit reference colour; score = worst stripe
